## Review target

- Page URL:
- Preview revision / commit SHA:
- Viewport / device:
- Reviewer perspective: technical recruiter / R&D lead / product stakeholder / accessibility-performance / other

## Observation

Describe one concrete issue. Avoid combining unrelated defects.

## Severity

- [ ] Critical — broken page, false/publicly unsafe claim, inaccessible core action
- [ ] Major — positioning, hierarchy, responsive or evidence problem that materially changes interpretation
- [ ] Minor — local usability, copy or visual defect
- [ ] Suggestion — optional improvement

## Category

- [ ] Positioning
- [ ] Content
- [ ] Evidence / claim boundary
- [ ] Visual hierarchy
- [ ] Motion
- [ ] Accessibility
- [ ] Responsive layout
- [ ] SEO / GEO
- [ ] Performance
- [ ] Navigation

## Evidence

Provide selector, screenshot reference, viewport, broken link, source file, repository evidence or exact copy that demonstrates the issue.

## Expected result

State the desired behaviour or interpretation.

## CAPA

### Root cause

Why did this defect reach preview?

### Corrective action

What change fixes this instance?

### Preventive action

What shared rule, component, prompt stage, test or review gate should change so this class of defect is less likely to recur?

### Verification

How will the correction be verified on the deployed preview?

## Closure

- [ ] Corrective action implemented
- [ ] Preventive action implemented or explicitly not applicable
- [ ] Preview rechecked
- [ ] Claim/evidence boundary rechecked when relevant
- [ ] Ready to close
